# Which of your Ghost members are worth keeping, and which are ready to pay?

> Free analyzer for Ghost publishers: drop in your members export CSV and see paid and free members, free-to-paid conversion, who never opens your emails, what cleaning the list saves, conversion by label and growth. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
